parsed.name: Opentrons ATC 自动热循环仪
parsed.description: 用于PCR等核酸扩增流程的自动热循环仪模块，提供程序化温度循环（变性、退火、延伸）并配备可开合加热上盖，支持在自动化实验流程中进行板式样本温控。
parsed.description_en: An automated thermocycler module for PCR and related nucleic acid amplification workflows, providing programmed temperature cycling (denaturation, annealing, extension) with an opening heated lid for plate-based sample temperature control in automated lab protocols.
